agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 15, 2022 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the May 18, 2022, Special Joint Meeting with the City Council, May 18, 2022, and May 25, 2022 Regular Meeting, Regular Adjourned Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2022-06-15 SDWD Item S08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the Board review and approve the warrants.
2022-06-15 SDWD Item S08C Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Wanket Reservoir Assignment and Assumption Agreement (“Agreement”), between the San Dieguito Water District (“San Dieguito” or “SDWD”) and the San Eljio Joint Powers Authority (“SEJPA” or “Assignee”) and consented to by the Olivenhain Municipal Water District (“Olivenhain”). And License agreement and right of entry for J.C. Wanket Reservoir between SDWD and SEJPA. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Olson
1) Wanket Tank Assignment Agreement for $136,796.40; and 2) License agreement and right of entry for J.C. Wanket Reservoir.
2022-06-15 SDWD Item S08D Wanket Tank Agreement
8E.
Approval of plans and authorization to advertise for the Encinitas Valve Replacement Project (CW22X). Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Olson
1) Approve the plans for the Encinitas Valve Replacement Project (CW22X); 2) Authorize advertisement of the Encinitas Valve Replacement Project (CW22X) for construction bids; and 3) Adopt Resolution No 2022-05, titled “A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Approving the Design and Plans for Construction of the Encinitas Valve Replacement Project, Pursuant to Government Code Section 830.6.”
2022-06-15 SDWD Item S08E Encinitas Valve Replacement Design Approval
8F.
San Dieguito Water District Fiscal Year 2021-22 3rd Quarter Budget Report. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
1) Receive and file this report reflecting a revised projected available net position of $13,111,680; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2022-06, titled “A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2021-22 Budget”.
2022-06-15 SDWD Item S08F FY21-22 3rd Quarter Budget Report
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board.
10A.
A hearing to consider customer appeal of District denial for a revised water bill for 1153 Crest Drive. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
1) Consider the matters set forth herein, deny the appeal and affirm the staff decision that the customer pay the full unrevised water bill; or 2) Discuss and take action as appropriate.
2022-06-15 SDWD Item S10A Customer Appeal of District Water Bill
10B.
Introduction and Adoption of Fiscal Year 2022/23 San Dieguito Water District Budget (“Second-Year Revise”) Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2022-07 titled “A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District, Adopting the Fiscal Year 2022/23 San Dieguito Water District Operating and Capital Budget;” and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2022-08 titled “A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Adopting Position Titles and Pay Ranges for Fiscal Year 2022-23.”
2022-06-15 SDWD Item S10B FY22-23 Second Year Revise Budget Adoption
10C.
Public Hearing Regarding San Dieguito Water District's 2021 Public Health Goals Report. Contact Person: Water Operations Manager Gonzalez
The District Board receive public comments regarding San Dieguito Water District's 2021 Public Health Goals Report, review and discuss the information presented, advise staff of any changes desired by the Board, and accept the report.
2022-06-15 SDWD Item S10C Public Health Goals Report
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS – NONE
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON AUGUST 17, 2022
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
